title: The daily tape · 20 August 2026
description: Daily tape · 20 Aug 2026. Country signals and sourced silicon prints. Labeled terms only — no invented 7-day moves.
og_kicker: Country conversion signals and sourced silicon prints.
lede: ERCOT put numbers on the Texas freeze this morning: PUCT 59142 Item 52, filed 09:01, asks to conditionally classify Batch Zero by 31 Aug and holds 17 large DC/crypto loads (6,608 MW) off energization until a 10 Dec verification report. No Commission order posted yet. Shapiro’s 18 Aug EO gates Pennsylvania data centers over 25 MW. The Silicon Tape did not tick — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: ERCOT filed PUCT Project 59142 Item 52 at 09:01 on 20 Aug: three pending good-cause exceptions (conditional classify by 31 Aug; QSA inclusion of 6 loads ≈1,959 MW and 17 ≈6,874 MW; late dynamic-data notices). Energization pause on large DC/crypto; 17 loads / 6,608 MW peak over 5 years await ERCOT approval. Reports 10 Dec, Open Meeting 17 Dec. April snapshot 157 medium loads ≈8,766 MW. 290 dynamic models, ~18% first-pass. No minutes or order posted. Source: ERCOT / PUCT Interchange 59142_52.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Governor Shapiro signed EO 2026-05 on 18 Aug, effective immediately: DEP Consent Order for any data center over 25 MW peak, Fast Track removal, NDA ban, GRID-tied sales-tax exemption. Recitals: 20 DEP applications, PJM 74 GW through 2045. Source: Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Amazon (18 Aug) raised northwest Louisiana from $12B to $18B and added a third STACK campus in Shreveport. SWEPCO 100% of new energy infra; up to $400M water on Amazon’s tab. IT-MW not disclosed. Source: Amazon.

countries.name: China
countries.note: FT (19 Aug): ByteDance and Tencent each ~10,000 H200s; Beijing steering most volume to Hong Kong. No new BIS/NDRC/IR primary on 20 Aug. Already on The Wire.
